title: Budgets and monthly finance reports

steps: Start at the official annual budget/audit or monthly-report index.
Choose the exact document and reporting period; inspect its column definitions.
For community-extracted CSVs, read the finance package README, dictionary, coverage and issues before analysis.
contact: Office of Policy, Management and Grants; data-maintenance contact unconfirmed. Community package README publishes contact@miscellany.blog for corrections.

Community extracts are a research preview with incomplete review, not city-validated data.
Missing payment-register coverage means unavailable data, not zero payments.
Monthly financial measures and aggregation levels must not be summed indiscriminately.
